risks.description: The local host provides Node.js 25.9.0 while the frozen application baseline is Node.js 24.18.0.
risks.impact: The current dependency-free filesystem and cryptographic verifier uses only stable Node.js core APIs, but the environment is not the future application runtime baseline.
risks.mitigation: Rerun the verifier under Node.js 24.18.0 when the repository toolchain is bootstrapped; no application dependency or runtime substitution was committed.

risks.description: The repository had no tracked CI configuration.
risks.impact: The deterministic verifier is locally executable but is not yet an enforced GitHub required check.
risks.mitigation: Keep this script as the deterministic source and integrate the approved reusable workflow in its separately scoped Phase 0 CI task.

risks.description: The canonical Development Readiness Report v1.0 refers internally to Phase 0 Codex Pack v1.2, while the approved source supplied for adoption is v1.3.
risks.impact: A reader may notice a stale historical version reference.
risks.mitigation: The readiness report was preserved byte-for-byte, while the user-required manifest and exact-version checks pin the adopted Codex Pack to v1.3. Any source correction must be a separately approved versioned governance change.

risks.description: GitHub CLI is not installed in the execution environment.
risks.impact: CLI-based Draft PR creation is unavailable.
risks.mitigation: Use authenticated Git push plus the connected GitHub application for Draft PR creation.
